chunks: From him, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Zurārah, who said:

I asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who is on the Day of ʿArafah, and between him and Makkah are three miles, while he is performing tamattuʿ with ʿumrah leading to hajj. He said: He cuts off the talbiyah of the tamattuʿ, and begins the hajj with the talbiyah when he has performed Fajr salat (prayer), then proceeds to ʿArafāt and stands with the people, completes all the rites, and remains in Makkah until he performs the ʿumrah of al-Muḥarram, and there is nothing upon him.

Do you not see that in the first report he directed the address to one who feared missing the standing, and in the second report to one between whom and Makkah are three miles? And it is known that one whose condition is like this cannot enter Makkah, become occupied with exiting ihram and then entering ihram afterward, and still catch up with the people at ʿArafāt. Whenever that is not possible for him, then his duty is to continue in his ihram and make it an individual hajj, as we have mentioned.

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: the pilgrimage invocation by which one enters or continues the state of ihram
key_terms.الْإِحْرَامِ: the consecrated pilgrim state entered for hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.الْمَنَاسِكِ: the ritual acts and rites of hajj to be completed
key_terms.الْمَوْقِفِ: the standing-place, here referring to the standing at ʿArafāt
key_terms.حَجَّةً مُفْرَدَةً: an individual hajj performed separately rather than as tamattuʿ
key_terms.مُتَمَتِّعٌ: one performing hajj al-tamattuʿ, combining ʿumrah and hajj in the prescribed manner
key_terms.يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ: the Day of ʿArafah, the critical time connected to the standing at ʿArafāt

ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim in tamattuʿ do if he fears missing the standing at ʿArafāt?
ai.summary: This report addresses the legal ruling for a pilgrim performing tamattuʿ who is too close to the time of the standing at ʿArafāt to return to Makkah and complete the normal transition between ʿumrah and hajj. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that he proceed directly with hajj and complete the rites, while the closing discussion clarifies that in such a case his obligation becomes to continue in ihram and treat it as an individual hajj.
